verses.original: Ἐὰν ταῖς γλώσσαις τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαλῶ καὶ τῶν ἀγγέλων ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω γέγονα χαλκὸς ἠχῶν ἢ κύμβαλον ἀλαλάζον
verses.transliteration: Ean tais glōssais tōn anthrōpōn lalō kai tōn angelōn agapēn de mē echō gegona chalkos ēchōn ē kymbalon alalazon
verses.literal: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels but have not love I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal
verses.literalPt: AINDA que eu falasse as línguas dos homens e dos anjos, e não tivesse amor, seria como o metal que soa ou como o sino que tine.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἔχω προφητείαν καὶ εἰδῶ τὰ μυστήρια πάντα καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γνῶσιν καὶ ἐὰν ἔχω πᾶσαν τὴν πίστιν ὥστε ὄρη μεθιστάναι ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω οὐθέν εἰμι
verses.transliteration: kai ean echō prophēteian kai eidō ta mystēria panta kai pasan tēn gnōsin kai ean echō pasan tēn pistin hōste orē methistanai agapēn de mē echō outhen eimi
verses.literal: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains but have not love I am nothing
verses.literalPt: E ainda que tivesse o dom de profecia, e conhecesse todos os mistérios e toda a ciência, e ainda que tivesse toda a fé, de maneira tal que transportasse os montes, e não tivesse amor, nada seria.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ψωμίσω πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντά μου καὶ ἐὰν παραδῶ τὸ σῶμά μου ἵνα καυχήσωμαι ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω οὐδὲν ὠφελοῦμαι
verses.transliteration: kai ean psōmisō panta ta hyparchonta mou kai ean paradō to sōma mou hina kauchēsōmai agapēn de mē echō ouden ōpheloumai
verses.literal: If I give all I possess to the poor and - exult in the surrender of my body but have not love I gain nothing
verses.literalPt: E ainda que distribuísse toda a minha fortuna para sustento dos pobres, e ainda que entregasse o meu corpo para ser queimado, e não tivesse amor, nada disso me aproveitaria.

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη μακροθυμεῖ χρηστεύεται ἡ ἀγάπη οὐ ζηλοῖ ἡ ἀγάπη οὐ περπερεύεται οὐ φυσιοῦται
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē makrothymei chrēsteuetai hē agapē ou zēloi hē agapē ou perpereuetai ou physioutai
verses.literal: Love is patient love is kind It does not envy it does not boast it is not proud
verses.literalPt: O amor é sofredor, é benigno; o amor não é invejoso; o amor não trata com leviandade, não se ensoberbece.

verses.original: οὐκ ἀσχημονεῖ οὐ ζητεῖ τὰ ἑαυτῆς οὐ παροξύνεται οὐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν
verses.transliteration: ouk aschēmonei ou zētei ta heautēs ou paroxynetai ou logizetai to kakon
verses.literal: It is not rude it is not self-seeking . . . . . . it is not easily angered it keeps no account of wrongs
verses.literalPt: Não se porta com indecência, não busca os seus interesses, não se irrita, não suspeita mal;

verses.original: οὐ χαίρει ἐπὶ τῇ ἀδικίᾳ συνχαίρει δὲ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: ou chairei epi tē adikia synchairei de tē alētheia
verses.literal: Love takes no pleasure in evil but rejoices in the truth
verses.literalPt: Não folga com a injustiça, mas folga com a verdade;

verses.original: πάντα στέγει πάντα πιστεύει πάντα ἐλπίζει πάντα ὑπομένει
verses.transliteration: panta stegei panta pisteuei panta elpizei panta hypomenei
verses.literal: It bears all things believes all things hopes all things endures all things
verses.literalPt: Tudo sofre, tudo crê, tudo espera, tudo suporta.

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη οὐδέποτε πίπτει εἴτε δὲ προφητεῖαι καταργηθήσονται εἴτε γλῶσσαι παύσονται εἴτε γνῶσις καταργηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē oudepote piptei eite de prophēteiai katargēthēsontai eite glōssai pausontai eite gnōsis katargēthēsetai
verses.literal: Love never fails But where there are prophecies they will cease where there are tongues they will be restrained where there is knowledge it will be dismissed
verses.literalPt: O amor nunca falha; mas havendo profecias, serão aniquiladas; havendo línguas, cessarão; havendo ciência, desaparecerá;

verses.original: ἐκ μέρους γὰρ γινώσκομεν καὶ ἐκ μέρους προφητεύομεν
verses.transliteration: ek merous gar ginōskomen kai ek merous prophēteuomen
verses.literal: For we know in part and we prophesy in part
verses.literalPt: Porque, em parte, conhecemos, e em parte profetizamos;

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ τὸ τέλειον τὸ ἐκ μέρους καταργηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: hotan de elthē to teleion to ek merous katargēthēsetai
verses.literal: but when the perfect comes the partial passes away
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando vier o que é perfeito, então o que o é em parte será aniquilado.

verses.original: Ὅτε ἤμην νήπιος ἐλάλουν ὡς νήπιος ἐφρόνουν ὡς νήπιος ἐλογιζόμην ὡς νήπιος ὅτε γέγονα ἀνήρ κατήργηκα τὰ τοῦ νηπίου
verses.transliteration: Hote ēmēn nēpios elaloun hōs nēpios ephronoun hōs nēpios elogizomēn hōs nēpios hote gegona anēr katērgēka ta tou nēpiou
verses.literal: When I was a child I talked like a child I thought like a child I reasoned like a child When I became a man I set aside childish ways
verses.literalPt: Quando eu era menino, falava como menino, sentia como menino, discorria como menino, mas, logo que cheguei a ser homem, acabei com as coisas de menino.

verses.original: βλέπομεν γὰρ ἄρτι δι’ ἐσόπτρου ἐν αἰνίγματι τότε δὲ πρόσωπον πρὸς πρόσωπον ἄρτι γινώσκω ἐκ μέρους τότε δὲ ἐπιγνώσομαι καθὼς καὶ ἐπεγνώσθην
verses.transliteration: blepomen gar arti di’ esoptrou en ainigmati tote de prosōpon pros prosōpon arti ginōskō ek merous tote de epignōsomai kathōs kai epegnōsthēn
verses.literal: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror then we shall see face to face Now I know in part then I shall know fully even as I am fully known
verses.literalPt: Porque agora vemos por espelho em enigma, mas então veremos face a face; agora conheço em parte, mas então conhecerei como também sou conhecido.

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ μένει πίστις ἐλπίς ἀγάπη τὰ τρία ταῦτα μείζων δὲ τούτων ἡ ἀγάπη
verses.transliteration: Nyni de menei pistis elpis agapē ta tria tauta meizōn de toutōn hē agapē
verses.literal: And now these three remain faith hope and love but the greatest of these is love
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, permanecem a fé, a esperança e o amor, estes três, mas o maior destes é o amor.
